value.content: {"id": "recon_meth_009", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "name": "Public Repository OSINT & Secret Auditing (GitHub Dorking)", "prerequisites": ["git_architecture", "secret_scanning"], "signals": ["github_code_search", "hardcoded_credentials", "api_key_regex", "trufflehog_verified"], "verification_strategy": "Search public code hosting platforms (GitHub, GitLab) for company domains paired with high-entropy credential keywords (API_KEY, Credentials, secret, password) using automated tools and tokenized queries.", "evidence_requirements": ["repository_commit_url", "verified_api_token_entropy", "active_secret_verification"], "remediation_pattern": "Integrate pre-commit git hooks (git-secrets, detect-secrets, TruffleHog) in developer pipelines, rotate leaked credentials immediately, and enforce cloud secret managers.", "description": "Detection of hardcoded secrets, private cryptographic keys, and backend API credentials accidentally published to public version control repositories by developers."}
